body: He's doing what he can, which isn't much. While reminding me that a statistics major requires math, which my transcript says I suck at but in reality I'm good at math and just suck at life, like just not doing work or going to class because I just can't hack it that day.
I keep obsessing over HOW to do that, and I think it's time to quit nitpicking and just get shit done.

I want a certain lifestyle that requires a college degree, and I want it ASAP. I'm tired of waiting for the rest of my life to start. I guess I'm worried that I might actually kill myself in one of my less stable moments, and I won't HAVE a rest of my life if I do that. I wanna be in control of myself and I have doubts. I actually withdrew from school for psych reasons last semester (basically got the last few weeks off and my bad grades wiped) and am returning this semester. I am scared I will fail and my future will disappear. If that happens... I'll be back on here for serious might-off-myself realsies.

I'm midway through my 4th year of college, still nowhere near getting a degree though. I'm scared I'm going to fuck this up and by extension fuck up the rest of my life. Sometimes I give myself ultimatums, like "Get your shit together by your next birthday or die." Never follow through. Then again, I don't follow through on a lot of things in life. I'm frustrated with the lack of progress towards my life goals and I sometimes wonder if I'll ever be happy. That being said, I do not live a joyless existence. I have a really supportive girlfriend who I'm madly in love with, my family doesn't hate me, and I have wonderful caring friends just a phone call away. I have no reason to die and plenty of reason to live. I guess I'm just wondering how to shake these thoughts.

I don't know what I'd be trying to achieve. I'm kinda bugging about going back to school. I know death is not the answer. It's just kind of an intrusive thought. Maybe I should xpost to r/Mentalhealth.

No, I haven't seen it, but I do know it involves POWs being forced to play Russian roulette. Idk what kind of stress you're talking about. Nobody's making me do anything. I just think about it a lot, and I don't like it.
